messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED marta (oncall) — High error rate detected for /v1/embeddings in us-west-2 (10.6% 500s, 5m). Suspected routing fallback to an incompatible variant. AlertID: ALRT-emb-2222

marta (oncall): I got the page, taking this. Starting look. @samir can you pull routing logs & recent pins for alias=prod-embeds-usw2?

samir: pulling logs now. quick read — lots of 500s with stack: 

```
Error: handler.assertVariantCompatibility failed
request_type=embeddings, selected_variant=redwood-chat-v1, model_version=v2025-11
```

samir: looks like a pinned model/version exists for that alias but routing fallback is selecting a chat variant when embeddings requests arrive. grabbing pin config...

leo: fyi I see traffic spike from customer "acme-marketing" hitting embeddings endpoint around same time. Could be correlated.

samir: routing config snippet for alias prod-embeds-usw2:

```
alias: prod-embeds-usw2
pinned_model: redwood-embed-v2
pinned_version: v2025-11
policy: prefer_pinned_then_compatible
fallback_order:
  - redwood-chat-v1
  - redwood-embed-v1
```

samir: important bit — fallback_order lists chat variant before embed v1. If pinned version isn't available on some nodes, the router falls through to chat. That explains incompatible variant selection.

asha: how widespread? any 4xx vs 5xx split?

samir: breakdown last 10m: total requests 120k -> 500s 12.7k, 4xx 1.1k. Errors mostly from handler.assertVariantCompatibility and downstream model runtime returning 502 when chat variant receives embedding payload.

marta (oncall): thanks. Immediate mitigation options: (A) unpin alias so router will pick a compatible variant by request type, (B) update fallback_order to put embed variants first, (C) temporary edge rewrite to coerce routing by request_type. Fastest is unpin. Any objections?

leo: unpin sounds safest and quick. Need to page-prod change and note in audit.

samir: I can run the unpin. Command: 

```
# unpin alias (dry-run shown)
rictl routing unpin --alias prod-embeds-usw2 --confirm
```

samir: running unpin now...

ops-bot: Started job job-9987: routing.unpin for prod-embeds-usw2 (initiated by samir)

samir: done. Job job-9987 completed, alias unpinned. New effective policy: prefer_compatible_by_request_type -> router will favor embed variants for embeddings.

marta (oncall): monitoring. @cs-jordan can you message the customers on the list (acme-marketing + growth-saas) and let them know we are mitigating? Be transparent about possible short-term embed failures.

cs-jordan: pinged both accounts with a short note. they replied: acme says they saw ~15% embed failures since 14:02 UTC; growth-saas saw intermittent latencies but no major errors so far.

samir: metrics update 3m after unpin: error rate dropped from 10.6% -> 0.8% 500s, request success rate back to baseline.

marta (oncall): good. creating short incident record. Initial severity: Sev2 (customer-impacting embeds). Root cause: pinned alias had fallback_order that prioritized an incompatible chat variant; when pinned version partially unavailable, router selected chat variant for embeddings.

asha: action items: 1) fix fallback_order to prefer embed variants (owner: samir) 2) add preflight compatibility checks on routing decision (owner: eng-runtime) 3) audit aliases for mismatched fallback heuristics (owner: ops). I'll add to postmortem.

leo: also recommend adding an automated invariant: if request_type==embeddings then selected_variant must have capability==embed, else route reject with clear 4xx instead of falling back. That would reduce customer 500 exposure.

marta (oncall): Agreed. Logging: put incident into slack channel #incidents with label "embed-routing-pin-mismatch" and set followup meeting tomorrow at 10:00 UTC. Assigning postmortem to asha.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2222 — "embed routing pin mismatch" assigned to asha, severity Sev2

asha: I'll own the postmortem. Samir, can you push the fallback_order config change and a quick canary test? Put a feature flag so we can rollback.

samir: pushing change to routing repo now. PR: https://git.redwood.org/routing/PR/4521 — updating fallback_order and adding a unit test for compatibility selection. Will merge to canary.

marta (oncall): good job team. Closing pager. If any customer escalations come in, reopen thread.

cs-jordan: acme acknowledged the message and said they are back to normal. thanking team. :white_check_mark:
